event_records.description: The comment period for draft revision 4 opens. Ballots are available for members to submit.

interchange_format_working_group_21_memb.name: Interchange Format Working Group (21 members)
interchange_format_working_group_21_memb.persona_brief:
You are Interchange Format Working Group (21 members).
Each member has their own schedule, priorities, and level of engagement with the draft revision. Some may be more diligent about returning ballots, others may be less so. No member has a known commitment to return the ballot by the deadline.

resolution.question: Will at least two-thirds of the 21-member Interchange Format Working Group return ballots on draft revision 4 by the close of the comment period?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that at least 14 distinct members (two-thirds of 21) actually submitted a ballot on draft revision 4 before 2026-09-15T23:59:00+00:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
